goal_name: Ensure system and application access control

subgoals.objective_name: To prevent unauthorized access to systems and applications.
subgoals.goal_name: Prevent unauthorized access to systems and applications

subgoals.control_name: Access to information and application system functions shall be restricted in accordance with the access control policy.

subgoals.goal_name: Restrict access to information and application system functions in accordance with the access control policy

actions.label: Control Flow Integrity
actions.definition: Enforcing legal control flow transfers during application process execution.

subgoals.control_name: Where required by the access control policy, access to systems and applications shall be controlled by a secure log-on procedure.

subgoals.goal_name: Control where required by the access control policy, access to systems and applications

actions.label: Control Flow Integrity
actions.definition: Enforcing legal control flow transfers during application process execution.

subgoals.control_name: Password management systems shall be interactive and shall ensure quality passwords.

subgoals.goal_name: Ensure password management systems are interactive and shall ensure quality passwords

subgoals.control_name: The use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

subgoals.goal_name: Restrict the use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls and tightly controlled

subgoals.control_name: Access to program source code shall be restricted.

subgoals.goal_name: Restrict access to program source code

actions.label: Remote File Access Mediation
actions.definition: Remote file access mediation is the process of managing and securing access to file systems over a network to ensure that only authorized users or processes can interact with remote files.

actions.label: Local File Permissions
actions.definition: Local file permissions is the systematic process of defining, implementing, and managing access control policies that dictate user permissions for accessing files on a local system through the configuration of operating system functionality.

actions.label: Content Filtering
actions.definition: Content Filtering techniques aid in the process of analyzing an input file for malicious or erroneous content and outputing a sanitized version.
